title: Workday and The Josh Bersin Company Bring Galileo Agent to Workday Customers in Sana, Giving HR Leaders Instant Access to Trusted Expertise
summary: HR Leaders Will Be Able to Ask About Hiring, Skills, or Team Design, and Get Answers Drawn From The Josh Bersin Company's Research and Best Practices PLEASANTON, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
body_markdown:
*HR Leaders Will Be Able to Ask About Hiring, Skills, or Team Design, and Get Answers Drawn From The Josh Bersin Company's Research and Best Practices*


PLEASANTON, Calif.


, Nov. 12, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Workday, Inc.](https://www.workday.com/en-us/homepage.html) (NASDAQ: WDAY), the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, and The Josh Bersin Company, today announced they will make Galileo, The Josh Bersin Company's AI-powered HR research and advisory agent, available to Workday customers in[Sana](https://www.workday.com/en-us/ai-agents/sana.html) . By bringing decades of HR research, benchmarks, and best practices directly into Sana—Workday's agentic experience and orchestration engine—Galileo will help leaders move beyond generic advice to explore strategic workforce challenges with guidance tailored to their organizational context.


Behind Galileo are decades of research from The Josh Bersin Company, a globally recognized HR research and advisory firm whose work has helped shape how organizations approach talent management, leadership, and workforce strategy. This partnership highlights Workday's open approach to AI, where specialized partner agents like Galileo operate alongside native Workday agents and data to give customers direct access to deep domain expertise where they already work.


With Galileo in Sana, HR leaders and managers will be able to ask questions in natural language and receive guidance drawn from The Josh Bersin Company's research, benchmarks, and best practices, without spending hours researching or piecing together information from multiple sources. Galileo draws on more than 50,000 pages of research covering hiring, employee development, workforce planning, leadership, and organizational design.


For example, a leader planning to expand into a new market can ask Galileo how other companies have approached similar expansions, which skills they needed, and how they got their teams up and running quickly. Rather than relying on trial and error, the leader can draw on research and real-world examples to make more informed decisions.


"HR leaders are navigating rapid workforce changes, and having immediate access to proven expertise is critical," said Nikki Helmer, vice president, talent management and insights, Workday. "By bringing specialized partner agents like Galileo into Sana, we are giving organizations a trusted advisory resource right in their daily workflow, helping them evaluate workforce strategies with greater speed and confidence."


**Expert Guidance With the Data Protections Organizations Already Trust**


Through the integration into Sana, Galileo will operate within the existing security policies, permissions, and access controls organizations already rely on. Leaders can explore strategic scenarios informed by their organizational context while maintaining strict data privacy and access management. Crucially, Galileo is designed to advise on workforce strategy, including hiring approaches, skills development, and organizational design, rather than make employment decisions.


**Helping Organizations Prepare for the Future of Work**


The Galileo integration is part of Workday and The Josh Bersin Company's broader HR 2030 initiative, which is focused on helping organizations prepare for a future where people and AI work together. The partnership combines ongoing research with practical advice to help leaders understand how work is changing, decide where to focus their efforts, and prepare their teams for what's ahead.


"HR leaders don't need another dashboard or another report; they need to know what works," said Josh Bersin, Global Industry Analyst and CEO, The Josh Bersin Company. "Galileo brings our research and experience directly into their workflow, so they can learn from what other organizations have done rather than starting from scratch."


To further support workforce leaders, the companies are also developing a learning curriculum, planned for early 2027, to help HR professionals build the skills needed to guide their organizations through this transformation. Together with Galileo and the companies' HR 2030 research, the curriculum will give leaders practical resources to plan for the future and put new approaches into practice.


**Availability**


Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) customers can purchase Galileo through Workday now. The integrated Galileo agent is expected to be available to Sana Enterprise customers in February 2027.
